title: Winter Park Historical Museum

services.name: Past Exhibits
services.desc: Discover the agricultural heritage that helped shape Winter Park. Golden Roots: The Citrus Legacy of Winter Park explores how citrus transformed the city’s economy, landscape, and community-and helped establish Central Florida’s reputation as a place of sunshine, health, and opportunity. Long before Winter Park became known as the “City of Homes,” orange groves, packing houses, and railroads were central to life in the growing community. Citrus attracted settlers, supported local businesses, and connected Winter Park to markets across the nation. services.name: Walking Tour
services.desc: This self-guided walking tour is an introduction to our beautiful community and the historic buildings of Winter Park. There are twenty stops on the main tour. For the more intrepid walker there are four additional sites on the north end of Park Avenue. The first stop is the Winter Park Historical Museum located in the Winter Park Farmers Market building at 200 W. New England Avenue where you can pick up your free walking tour brochure.
